title: 第13章 超量暴击太初极道圣典修为再次暴涨第14章 既然你们找死那我就成全你们
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: “奖励？”
苏长歌属实没想到，师尊这次竟然会给自己发奖励。
那岂有不要之理？
“师尊，徒儿不挑的，你给什么，徒儿就要什么。”
他淡淡笑道。
叶清瑶思索片刻，从怀里取出一颗金色丹药，笑道：“此为涅盘神凤丹，拥有极强的恢复力，重伤之人只要还有一口气，只需服用此物，伤势就会在一息内尽数恢复，重回巅峰状态。
来，拿着。”
苏长歌伸手接过，只见此物圆圆的，通体金色，闻上去有扑鼻香气，浓郁无比。
一瞬间，他心头大喜。
这可是疗伤圣药啊！
有了此物，自己可以说拥有一张复活机会了。
就像前世玩的某讯游戏一样，身上穿着一件复活甲。
旋即，他起身告退。
刚回到住处，系统补贴准时到账！
【你送出了一本《太玄斩道圣典》，百亿补贴生效，触发超量暴击！
【本次超量暴击倍数：三十六万五千倍！
【恭喜宿主获得：太初极道法典！
太初极道法典？
苏长歌心弦一动。
玄幻世界最恐怖的道兵便是极道兵器，那此物以“极道”
来命名，肯定不会是善茬！
系统声音响起。
【系统提示：源自上古时代一尊仙王强者的秘法，可同时锤炼肉身与神魂，共分十八层，修到极致，肉身坚若磐石，神魂强度也会一跃达到恐怖的地步，免疫一切精神攻击！
“卧槽！
果然不是善茬！”
苏长歌深深吸了一口凉气，着实被震惊到了。
时间划分：太古时代，上古时代，中古时代，近古时代，现在。
《太玄斩道圣典》只能锤炼神魂，但《太初极道法典》不仅能锤炼神魂，更能同时锤炼肉身！
两者皆可锤炼，这就恐怖了！
可以想象，当肉身与神魂在千锤百炼下，整个人一下子没有任何短板，那该多恐怖？
content_en:
"Reward?"
Su Changge really didn't expect that his master would give him a reward this time.
Is there any reason not to do so?
"Master, my disciple doesn't choose. Whatever you give me, my disciple will take what he wants."
He smiled lightly.
Ye Qingyao thought for a moment, took out a golden elixir from his arms, and said with a smile: "This is the Nirvana Divine Phoenix Pill, which has extremely strong recovery power. As long as a seriously injured person still has breath, just take this elixir, and the injury will be fully recovered within one breath and return to peak condition.
Come on, take it. "
Su Changge stretched out his hand to take it, and saw that the object was round and golden in color. It smelled of a tangy aroma, which was extremely rich.
For a moment, he was overjoyed.
This is the holy medicine for healing!
With this item, I can say that I have a chance of resurrection.
Just like a certain game he played in his previous life, he was wearing a piece of resurrection armor.
Immediately, he stood up and left.
~~~~~~
I just returned to my residence and the system subsidy arrived on time!
【bite!
[You gave away a copy of "Tai Xuan Dao Dao Sacred Book", tens of billions of subsidies took effect, triggering super critical hits!
[This super critical hit multiplier: 365,000 times!
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining: Taichu Jidao Code!
Taichu Ji Dao Code?
Su Changge's heart skipped a beat.
The most terrifying Dao weapon in the fantasy world is the Ji Dao weapon, so this thing is called "Ji Dao"
To name it, it will definitely not be a good thing!
The system sounds.
[System prompt: The secret method originated from a powerful Immortal King in ancient times can temper the physical body and the spiritual soul at the same time. It is divided into eighteen levels. When cultivated to the extreme, the physical body is as solid as a rock, and the strength of the spiritual soul will also reach terrifying levels, making it immune to all mental attacks!
“Fuck!
Sure enough, it’s not a good thing! "
Su Changge took a deep breath, truly shocked.
Time division: ancient times, ancient times, medieval times, modern times, and now.
"Tai Xuan Zhan Dao Sacred Code" can only temper the soul, but "Tai Chu Ji Dao Code" can not only temper the soul, but also temper the physical body at the same time!
Both can be tempered, which is terrifying!
You can imagine how terrifying it would be when the body and soul are tempered over and over again, and the whole person suddenly has no shortcomings.
title_en: Chapter 13: Super critical attack, Taichu Ji Dao Holy Scripture cultivation level skyrocketed again Chapter 14: Since you are seeking death, then I will help you
